title: Serenity Blue | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Gulf Front With Private Pool- Serenity Blue by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Serenity Blue by Royal Destinations Location: Dune Allen Address: 4635 W Co Hwy 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459 Details: Serenity Blue sits directly on the Gulf of Mexico, boasting 150 linear feet of pristine beach frontage on 1.2 acres. Located in walking distance of the restaurants and shops at Gulf Place in Santa Rosa Beach along Scenic Hwy 30A, this spectacular beach home features extraordinary views from the living room, dining room, kitchen, five bedrooms, sprawling porches, and the stunning pool. Breathtaking views immediately awaken your senses as you enter into the open concept living room, dining room, and kitchen with beautiful wood beams, travertine floors, and a gas fireplace. Next, walk outside to a large, covered porch, which is just steps away from the white sandy beaches and emerald waters uniquely found in the panhandle of Florida. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: Gulf Front -Parking Spaces: 4 - 6 in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 8, Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Gas Grill -*Small Events Welcome (With Approval) *Maximum Capacity: 50 people *Event Fee: $3,000 -Private Pool: 12’ x 30’ *Pool heat is available for an additional $330 (pre-tax) *The pool heater requires 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 14 5 Bedrooms / 4 Full & 2 Half Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) -TV Room with 2 Sets of Twin Bunks -Laundry (2 Sets of Washers and Dryers) -Half Bath Second Floor: -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4: Queen Bed -Bedroom 5: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
